mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls surge exceeding 200,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting strong labor demand and economic momentum.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses the 150,000 threshold.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production index crossing above 105 signals robust supply-side activity, boosting economic output and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses 105.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in federal funds rates and fall in unemployment rates signal conflicting policy and labor trends, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in federal funds rates signals accommodative monetary policy, fostering equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline within late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rates and rise in nonfarm payrolls above 150,000 trigger positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, reflecting strong labor market strength.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in industrial production indices over the past quarter signals robust supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: An inflationary spike in the CPIAUCSL index exceeding 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of higher interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.5%.
